got: CONTRADICTS the BRIEF's second hypothesis at the level of its premise: the MEASURED/OBSERVED/INFERRED/ASSUMED ladder exists only at knowledge/README.md:36-41, scoped there as the evidence contract for PATTERNS.md craft claims, and is referenced by no pipeline or notebook artifact. Notebook facts instead carry `confidence: high|medium|low` (NOTEBOOK-SCHEMA.md:46). One slot for two independent quantities: 'the ministry announced X at 08:10' is certain as an utterance and entirely unverified as a fact about the world. Present-broken rather than absent — the free-text reason string does carry basis informally and the reference run used it well ('medium — single aggregator, not verified against Glassnode/CryptoQuant primary', notebook.json:84) — but it is unstructured, unenforced, and unreadable downstream.

Consequence, citing G-000 rather than re-raising it: an unknown card would fall through `?? DEFAULT_DIMENSION` into 'The number', the worst possible column for it. Three further orphan groups have no column either: provenance of the claim (who said it, in what form, corroborated or not), event classification (what kind of thing this is), and the clock (what would resolve this, and when — `currency` is notebook shelf-life, not scheduled resolution). Column utilisation for this topic: 3/7 used, 4 orphan groups.
